author: Bruno Mulé
title: Joc Pederson accounts for all Texas offense in loss
desc: Pederson is slashing .246/.352/.458 with nine home runs, 25 RBI, and 27 runs scored against right-handed pitching across 214 plate appearances this season, though he had gone 3-for-21 over his previous eight games entering Monday.
impact: His two-run homer into the right-field seats in the third inning accounted for all of Texas' offense. Pederson finished 2-for-3 with a hit by pitch in the loss to Minnesota.

author: Chase Davis
title: Dustin May spins one-hit gem in 3-0 win
desc: Dustin May allowed no earned runs on one hit and one walk while striking out nine over nine innings in Monday's win over the Padres.
impact: After the shutout, May now owns a 3.75 ERA and 1. 14 with a 5-6 record across 14 starts. He allowed seven hard-hit balls and picked up 15 whiffs on 101 pitches en route to his first career complete game. Excluding his first two games of the season, he has a 2.54 ERA, 0.98 WHIP and 8.2 K/9 across 74.1 innings. He'll get the Royals next.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ryan Vilade connects for towering homer Monday
desc: Ryan Vilade went 2-for-4 with a home run, one run scored and two RBI in Monday's 4-3 loss to the Los Angeles Dodgers.
impact: Vilade opened the scoring with a 422-foot, two-run homer to left field off Eric Lauer in the first inning. With increased playing time recently, he's making the most of his opportunities, slashing .355/.382/.613 across 31 at-bats.

author: David Leisering
title: Jared Jones roughed up by Athletics on Monday
desc: Jared Jones allowed five runs on eight hits - including a pair of home runs - in four innings on Monday as the Pirates suffered an 11-2 loss to the Athletics.
impact: Jones walked one and struck out four but was hurt by the long ball as four of the five runs he allowed came via home runs. Jones served up a two-run homer to Nick Kurtz in the second and then another two-run shot to Jeff McNeil in the fourth. The young righthander is still shaking off the rust after missing all of last season though he does carry a solid 18:6 K:BB ratio across his 17.1 innings. However, he has allowed 12 runs on 22 hits (four home runs) across his first four starts. Jones' next start is scheduled for Sunday in Coors Field against the Rockies.

author: David Leisering
title: Endy Rodriguez perfect at plate Monday
desc: Endy Rodriguez went 3-for-3 with a solo home run and a walk on Monday during the Pirates' 11-2 loss to the Athletics.
impact: Rodriguez had a pair of singles and a walk before launching his third home run of the season in the eighth inning of Monday's loss. The Pirates have an interesting decision to make with Joey Bart (foot) nearing his return as they are unlikely to carry three catchers on the active roster. On one hand, Rodriguez is slashing .268/.423/.482 with three home runs, seven RBI, and a 16:15 K:BB ratio in 22 games played. On the other hand, Henry Davis is slashing .135/.236/.278 with five homers, 17 RBI, and a 31:14 K:BB ratio in 46 contests. He is hitting .103 (9-for-87) over the last month. Rodriguez certainly helped his chances on Monday, but stay tuned.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Martinez strikes out six batters Monday
desc: Nick Martinez gave up three runs on five hits and one walk while striking out six across 5.1 innings in Monday's 4-3 loss to the Los Angeles Dodgers.
impact: Martinez tied a season high with six strikeouts on Monday while allowing three earned runs. His only blemish came in the second inning, when he surrendered a three-run homer to Kyle Tucker. He settled in afterward and did not allow another run the rest of the outing. Martinez has been better than expected this season, posting a 2.60 ERA and 1.16 WHIP. He is scheduled to make his next start on Sunday against the Washington Nationals.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ryan Gusto struggles against Phillies
desc: Ryan Gusto gave up five runs on eight hits and three walks while recording one strikeout across 4.2 innings in Monday's 7-0 loss to the Philadelphia Phillies.
impact: After allowing no runs on three hits against the Arizona Diamondbacks on June 10, Gusto struggled on Monday, surrendering a season-high eight hits and the first two home runs he's allowed this season. One encouraging takeaway was his workload, as he threw a season-high 91 pitches, suggesting he's fully stretched out as a starter. Through three starts, he owns a 6.75 ERA and 1.78 WHIP and will look to bounce back in his next scheduled start on Saturday against the San Francisco Giants.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gleyber Torres leaves early Monday
desc: Gleyber Torres left Monday's series opener against the Astros early.
impact: Torres will continue to be further evaluated heading into Tuesday. He is day-to-day for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Chapman could be traded by Giants
desc: Matt Chapman has been named as a potential trade candidate this year.
impact: Willy Adames and Rafael Devers were also named as trade candidates. The Giants currently sit at 29-43, nine games out of a playoff spot. Barring a big winning streak in the next month, San Francisco is on track to sell at this year's deadline.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sam Haggerty signs minor league deal with Reds
desc: The Reds signed OF Sam Haggerty to a minor league contract.
impact: Haggerty was previously in the Rangers organization. He will add depth for the Reds.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Maverick Handley re-signs with Braves on minor league deal
desc: The Braves re-signed C Maverick Handley to a minor league contract.
impact: Handley returns to the Braves organization on a new minor league deal.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Webb signs minor league deal with Twins
desc: The Twins signed RHP Jacob Webb to a minor league contract.
impact: Webb was released by the Red Sox. He'll add pitching depth in the Twins organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Glasnow (back) remains shut down from throwing
desc: Tyler Glasnow remains shut down from throwing.
impact: Glasnow had been hopeful to start playing catch again soon as of last week, but he has yet to be cleared. He remains without a clear timetable to return.
